Add the selected A1 as a persistent whole 2D companion on authenticated Web and independent DeviceApp pages. Click feedback uses one unchanged open-eyed illustration with small rigid whole-image transforms, preserving the original proportions and alignment. Wheel, corner dragging and a 1% slider provide continuous uniform resizing; dragging toward the left/right/bottom progressively reveals half body, head or a hidden recall tab. Position, mode and scale persist separately for Web and device surfaces. Dialog protection, keyboard controls, pause and reduced motion are included.

The user's final direction is intact 2D. Segmented joints, deforming depth meshes and an attempted A1 3D derivative were rejected and removed from the active page/runtime assets. Exact native PNGs/prompts and rejected engineering evidence remain preserved and explicitly historical. Large independent hand/foot animation still requires complete authored pose frames. Default wardrobe remains unselected.

This PR also retains the earlier independent full-body VRM presentation: bounded state motion, playback-RMS mouth opening, local previews/model replacement, clean black/mirrored output and English/Simplified Chinese. The unchanged official pixiv development sample retains pinned provenance, SHA, copyright, licence and embedded permissions; it is separate from A1's current 2D layer.

Preserved project work includes A1 V1–V4/B1/C1/E1 and character rules, nine A1 outfit variants plus historical C1 variants, six A1 full-body views/four details, exact native prompts and hashes, the verified 21-member wardrobe archive, and the supplied-v5 team log No. 2 with AI declaration and render evidence. Remaining work includes complete A1 pose frames/original model authoring, specific-application/remote-PC execution, memory management, job archival/export, real voice/wake/AEC/cost, Python/cross-device audio presentation and Pi/iPhone/optics/RIG/posture evaluation. The selected Qwen3.8 Omni model previously had no matching wire adapter: the application only understood Qwen Audio and Gemini Live. This change adds an independent Omni realtime path so speech can query existing calendar/tools and the owner can explicitly share an image or selected screen during the same conversation.

The adapter maps nested PCM audio, semantic VAD, ASR, images and response/item/call IDs. Function outputs wait for the response to finish, all outputs resume generation once, and interrupted responses drop late audio/tool calls and unsent stale outputs. Existing ToolDispatcher, JobService, owner approval, memory access scope and the fixed-camera posture loop remain the authority; no general GUI executor or second queue is added.

The backend loads the staged private Key only with explicit qwen_omni/file configuration, without sourcing it or accepting file-provided endpoints. The public Realtime gateway is distinct from the recorded Chat-compatible base URL and older workspace route. Providers still default to none. Keys never enter the frontend, status, Git or credential hashes.

Owner-only browser controls share a manually selected image or browser-selected screen. Frames are re-encoded to bounded720p JPEGs at1fps, with backend consent/identity/size/rate checks. Stop, disconnect and late chooser/decode cleanup release capture. Already sent frames remain in the provider conversation. Images are not persisted by the application.

Validation on final application code:215 backend tests,21 frontend tests, Ruff across backend/scripts/tests, changed Python formatting, TypeScript and production Vite build pass. Desktop1440×1000 and390×844 browser flows used only synthetic media and a fake provider: start/share/stop/end, no later frames, ended tracks, no overflow, no JS errors or framework overlay. Post-reload browser console:0 errors/0 warnings. Staged Gitleaks and whitespace checks pass. One pre-existing Starlette/httpx TestClient deprecation remains.

With the owner's CNY5 synthetic-only allowance, five real connections covered setup, three calendar attempts and one generated-image question. The first interrupted calendar attempt failed on call_id and is retained. After lifecycle fixes, two calendar replies correctly spoke all three fictional meetings; the original two-utterance case passed. Synthetic last-speech to API audio receipt was3.176s and2.619s. The blue-image answer was correct. No real microphone or screen was captured. Successful envelopes do carry name/call_id, so missing provider fields are not claimed as the proven first-failure root cause.

Trial reservations total CNY4.1; known successful-response usage estimates total CNY0.106608 at a deliberately conservative all-token rate. Neither is a complete invoice: failed/cancelled usage is missing and billing was not confirmed. Trials are stopped; this is not a recurring budget or a production spending cap.

The earlier dated voice/computer-use research, latency acceptance plan and private setup helper remain included and are synchronized with the implementation. Evidence and reproducible fixtures: output/qa/2026-10-16-qwen-omni-integration/verification.md. Focused contract: desk-companion/docs/qwen-omni.md.

Remaining: real multilingual conversation/AEC/wake, final voice choice, actual browser playback/Pi timing and per-turn10-second timeout, Wayland/ARM64/iPhone, and bounded general GUI execution/read-back. PRs #4/#5 and main are not merged or altered by this delivery.
